nom: SUNDAY RILEY Juno Antioxidant + Superfood Face Oil

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin report the oil absorbs well and does not increase shine or cause new breakouts, though one warns it can feel too oily for night use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, flaky, or dehydrated skin (including desert/winter climates) most consistently describe strong, lasting hydration and softer, less flaky skin, though one dry-skin user reports the opposite, waking with flakes and dryness.
segments.combination: The one combination/oily reviewer calls it a staple that does not irritate her skin or trigger breakouts, even during rosacea flare-ups.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: many describe it as calming, non-irritating and even helpful for rosacea or fragrance allergies, while a few with sensitive skin report breakouts, dryness or being put off entirely by the scent.
segments.normal: A reviewer describing her skin as normal/dry reports worsened breakouts she attributes to the product.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (in their 40s, 60s, 68) report visible smoothing, softness and glow, with one calling it the best product she has used for aging, dry skin.

concerns.aging: Mature reviewers report smoother texture, fewer visible fine lines, and a more even, plumped look; no dissent specific to aging is voiced.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers with dry or dehydrated skin report strong, lasting relief from flakiness and tightness, sometimes described as their best solution for winter dryness; one dry-skin reviewer reports the product made her face drier and flakier.
concerns.redness: Reviewers with redness or rosacea generally report visible calming and reduced redness with regular use; no negative reports on redness specifically are noted.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers mention soothing compromised or reactive skin (contact dermatitis, eye rash, psoriasis on hands) without stinging or irritation.
concerns.spots: One reviewer reports lightened hyperpigmentation scars and another that dark spots are kept from settling in; effects are described gradually, not immediately.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report fewer breakouts, faster healing of individual pimples, and no new blemishes; however, several reviewers explicitly state it caused their worst breakouts or cystic acne and stopped use.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin mostly report the oil absorbs and does not add shine or grease by morning, though a couple describe it sitting on the skin as oily throughout the day, especially with generous application.

aspects.libelle: Slow absorption, sits oily on skin
Multi-use on hair, cuticles, nails, neck
Small bottle lasts a long time
Dropper dispenses oil poorly, too much at once

extraits.titre: I wanted to love it… made my face dry
extraits.texte: I love Sunday Riley, let's make that clear ! But… I wanted to love this oil but I returned it. This made my face so dry ! At first it's a oil so it's moisturizing but by morning I would have flakes of dry skin all over my cheeks. I also don't have dry skin. I kept trying it over a few times just to make sure and it for sure is the product. Hopefully this doesn't happen to others. Moving on to a different oil.

I picked this up to try as my skin was so dry. I use in the am over my moisturizer and before my makeup and my skin just soaks it up. Light faint smell( I am sensitive to smells and this is totally fine). My skin was so dry that I kept developing the cystic acne and this has helped 1000%! If you have dry skin over 40 this is a must.

Ugh… I love JUNO… and it might be up there in my holyiest of grails. Juno was one of the very last SR products I tried because honestly, I didn't know what to do with it or where to put it in my routine. I have sensitive, acne prone, rosacea skin and in the northeast winter my face is disgustingly dry. I now use Juno over moisturizer morning and night and I can't even properly described what it's done for my skin. More even skin tone, less texture, less redness and even less acne (which is insane because it DOES sit on top of my skin). Give JUNO a try… you won't be disappointed!

I have dry/normal with hormonal acne, especially very dry in the winter. I never had cystic acne, but a pimple or 2 sure and it always levels a mark after it flattens out. I am very careful with making sure all the products I use are non-comedogenic and overall decent ingredients. I had a small pimple on my chin the night I started this oil. I washed and toned with my usual products and put about 6 drops and rubbed on my face and added 3 my drops for my neck. It felt nice and soothing to my dry skin and absorbed in my skin within 10 minutes and I woke up with the zit totally flattened out! And since I've been using the oil nightly my skin has been moisturized and clear! Worth the $$

extraits.titre: Great Facial Oil for Oily, Acne Prone and Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: I purchased this oil from Boxycharm at a greatly reduced price and stored it in my refrigerator and It has stayed the same color and doesn't have a bad smell by the time I got to it. My skin loves this and doesn't cause breakouts. I love it!

I've used this for years and it's consistently helpful with my extremely dry and sensitive (doctor diagnosed) rosacea. I rub 4 drops between my hands and softly pat onto my dry or sightly damp face. My rosacea is truly horrendous so I do use other moisturizers (ice and a calming one from another brand) and I also moisturize frequently throughout the day. But even so, juno helps, doesn't exacerbate anything, and is pretty moderately priced considering how long it lasts me. I often get the smaller size bc I've found sometimes Sunday Riley products oxidize faster than I would expect.

I have very unproblematic skin and I love facial oils so I was excited to try this one. This oil gave me the worst breakouts of my life and I was in denial for a long time I was thinking these were hormonal breakouts but when I stopped using the oil the breakouts went away. I live in a pretty dry climate with normal/dry skin
